# customer-journey-group-access-mockup.png

**Type:** UI wireframe/mockup, screen 8 of the customer journey flow.
**Source context:** `## Customer Journey screen flow`, step 8,
configuring SASE Edge Appliance/Agent group access at selected
locations.

Left nav tree shows `Group Access Sites` selected under `Locations`.
Right panel "Group Access via SASE Agent" table with columns Name,
`SW` / `SW + Appliance` (radio choice), Bandwidth, Monthly Recurrent
Charge €, and a Remove action per row: `HQ` (SW, 1000, €7.5), `AT1`
(SW+Appliance, 500, €10), `CM1` (SW+Appliance, 1000, €11.9), `CR1`
(SW+Appliance, 500, €11), and an in-progress new row for `CG1`
(SW+Appliance, 500, €10) with an `Add` action being clicked. `OK`
(highlighted/clicked) and `Cancel` buttons.
